meta.title: Banking & Finance Services | Lenix Protocol
meta.description: Lenix runs money transfer, voluntary crypto liquidation, collateral lending, and custody for customers — with KYC, corridor limits, and quoted rates before you commit.

Hero.subtitle: Send Funds across borders, cash out crypto to fiat, borrow against vaulted collateral, and hold assets in Lenix custody — not white-label infrastructure for other banks.

Overview.title: Lenix operates the full workflow
Overview.description: You work with Lenix directly: verify identity, fund your account, request a transfer or liquidation, or post collateral for a loan. Rates, fees, and delivery status are visible before you confirm — finance and ops are not guessing what happens next.

Services.title: Core services for customers
Services.description: Each service has its own intake in the Lenix dashboard. Pick the workflow that matches what you need today.

transfer.title: Money transfer
transfer.desc: Move value from crypto to fiat and into a beneficiary bank account on corridors Lenix supports today.

liquidation.title: Asset liquidation
liquidation.desc: Voluntarily sell approved crypto holdings and receive fiat payout — separate from loan collateral liquidation.

lending.title: Collateral lending
lending.desc: Post eligible collateral and draw stablecoins or fiat while terms, LTV, and repayment schedules stay visible upfront.

custody.title: Custody & wallet
custody.desc: Hold and move supported assets through Lenix wallet and vault controls with activity history your team can audit.

transfer.label: Cross-border transfer
transfer.title: Crypto to bank, with corridor clarity
transfer.body: Initiate from your Lenix account, see the quoted rate and fees, and track handoff from on-chain receipt through fiat delivery — not a single pending flag with no context.

settlement.label: Fiat settlement
settlement.title: Treasury-ready payout records
settlement.body: Settlement details, beneficiary references, and status timestamps suitable for finance review — so cross-border payouts can be reconciled like any other treasury movement.

liquidation.label: Voluntary liquidation
liquidation.title: Cash out without a loan position
liquidation.body: Convert approved crypto to fiat when you choose to exit a holding. Quote, fees, and expected payout are shown before you confirm — this is not collateral seizure from an underwater loan.

lending.label: Collateral lending
lending.title: Liquidity while assets stay vaulted
lending.body: Draw against posted collateral with LTV, repayment schedule, and health indicators visible before disbursement. Collateral remains in segregated custody for the loan term.

custody.label: Custody & controls
custody.title: Hold, send, and receive in one place
custody.body: Multi-chain wallet access, transaction history, and vault segregation for assets under Lenix custody — with the same identity and compliance checks applied across services.

compliance.label: Compliance screening
compliance.title: KYC and flow screening before release
compliance.body: Identity verification for account opening and sanctions/AML screening on inbound and outbound flows — funds are not released until checks for that transaction complete.

account.title: Create your Lenix account
account.desc: Sign up, complete KYC, and set up payout details for the corridors you plan to use.

fund.title: Fund or deposit crypto
fund.desc: Add supported assets to your Lenix wallet or vault — the same balance can feed transfers, liquidation, or collateral posting.

request.title: Request a service
request.desc: Start a transfer, voluntary liquidation, or loan draw. Review the quote, fees, and terms before you confirm.

track.title: Track through delivery
track.desc: Follow status from initiation to bank credit or loan disbursement, with records available for your finance team.

Boundaries.subtitle: Lenix is a service operator, not a universal bank. Scope, corridors, and regulatory treatment depend on your jurisdiction and the product you use.

corridors.title: Supported corridors only
corridors.desc: Payout markets and banking rails are limited to corridors Lenix actively supports. Contact us if yours is not listed — we do not imply worldwide coverage.

kyc.title: KYC and AML required
kyc.desc: Account opening and most outbound flows require identity verification and transaction screening. We cannot bypass compliance for expedited payout.

quotes.title: Quotes before confirmation
quotes.desc: Rates, fees, and estimated delivery windows are shown before you submit a transfer, liquidation, or loan draw — not adjusted silently afterward.

liquidation_types.title: Two different liquidations
liquidation_types.desc: Voluntary asset liquidation is a customer-initiated cash-out. Loan collateral liquidation only applies when posted collateral falls below agreed LTV on an active loan.

timing.title: Delivery timing varies
timing.desc: Banking cutoffs, beneficiary bank processing, and corridor load affect settlement time. We show status updates; we do not guarantee instant fiat credit.

regulatory.title: Not a bank charter
regulatory.desc: Lenix provides crypto finance and settlement services under its operating licenses and partners. Product availability and protections vary by region — confirm what applies to you before moving funds.

Cta.title: Ready to use Lenix banking services?
Cta.description: Open an account to start transfers, liquidation, or lending — or contact us if you need a corridor or workflow scoped before signup.
